title: 039 NNPredict -- follow-ups 2 (user request 2026-10-21: 'do both'): the excursion-H32 Ridge as the gbb gate on st_g24_rev's exact exits
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test (constitution gate 2). Nothing is adopted by this stage; adoption is the user's call.

nnp_ridge_exc32_op_revx.change: st_g24_rev's framework on the exc32 Ridge class, trigger entry only: must reproduce st_g24_rev

nnp_ridge_exc32_op_revg.change: the same framework, model AND gbb: st_g24_rev's entries filtered by the excursion-H32 Ridge (z-score + percentile floor, as every 039 arm)

identity.rule: nnp_ridge_exc32_op_revx trades_hash == st_g24_rev's on all 15 folds; otherwise the copied framework is a defect: it is fixed (instrument only, rules unchanged) and rerun before nnp_ridge_exc32_op_revg is read

instrument: per arm: a record for all 15 folds, model trained per fold on its training window (run_folds strict artefact check), and trades in both halves; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (no P&L read)
alone: judge_one(arm, comparator) with the rule maps; liveness: an arm whose trades change on no fold vs its comparator is INERT (a defect)

decision.nnp_ridge_exc32_op_revg: identity must hold. PASS (both halves gain, paired not WORSENED) -> the exc32 model adds value over the gbb trigger on identical exits (candidate; user's call); FAIL -> its filter costs P&L vs the trigger alone

seen_before: every 039 verdict incl. follow-ups: nnp_lstm_ind_op_revg 50.57 vs st_g24_rev 71.50 (FAIL both halves)
nnp_ridge_exc32_op standalone -10.99 (PASS vs nnp_ridge_op), its early-half deciles: 8 h Spearman +0.95, gated entries +14.07 bp edge at 8 h
why: the deciles say the excursion-H32 prediction ranks the 8 h hold the right way, unlike the LSTM's; the test is whether that makes it a useful filter on gbb reversion entries. Nothing tuned: the gate is the existing trigger_and_model switch with the arm's own operating point.
caveat: chosen after seeing the exc32 deciles (early half) and the LSTM revg result; the late half is the cleaner test
